name: Self-contained implementation handoff plan
description: Reusable implementation-plan template recording intent, current-state excerpts, exact scope, drift checks, verification commands, dependency order, done criteria, stop conditions and maintenance notes for a context-independent executor.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Coding-agent host with read access to a target repository
Appropriate isolated execution tools for optional follow-through
